Correspondingly, `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` deletes `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts = nil` in the “raises an error with a missing host” test, so the test now passes as long as the `embeddable_hosts` table is empty (or referer is nil), and it no longer distinguishes “no hosts configured” from “invalid referer”. This is a real, diff-grounded test/behavior semantic change, but not necessarily a functional defect by itself.
